prerequisites: Ability to collect data, present it clearly and concisely, and analyze results.
Ability to make forecasts for different working conditions and estimate their reliability.
Ability to make decisions in an uncertain environment.
Contents of the first-year Statistics course of the Degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Design, elaborate, and manage quality and integrated systems.
Apply basic and advanced quality tools.
Propose and implement actions that improve process quality.

syllabus_topics: Quality models. ISO 9001 quality management model. Quality audits. System certification. EFQM excellence model.
Statistical process control. Basic and advanced tools. Guidelines for improvement.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, evaluation will be continuous through group and/or individual assignments and two theory exams, each covering approximately half of the content. Class attendance and active participation will also be valued. For the extraordinary call, a theoretical-practical exam will account for 60% of the grade, and individual and/or group assignments from the course will account for the remaining 40%. For the early extraordinary call, a theoretical-practical exam will account for 100% of the grade. In all cases, the final grade must be at least 5 out of 10 to pass the course.
